correctness.rationale: The 21 vertices correspond to K7 edges; faces are simple triangle-free graphs. Independently enumerated all 2^21 graph masks and found exactly 133,501 valid faces and the source face vector (1,21,210,1295,5355,15204,29344,37110,28875,12670,2961,420,35). The inspected homology_verifier.py fully describes an acyclic matching certified by topologically sorting 917,280 oriented Hasse incidences, 66,695 matchings, exact Morse Smith factors including 2-torsion. The separately inspected equivariant_verifier.py uses integral Morse inclusion/projection, verifies chain maps and computes traces on homology for all 15 symmetric-group classes with exact rational basis matrices. As an independent partial test, signed simplicial Lefschetz values for all 15 class representatives were independently enumerated and agree with the alternating sum of the three displayed graded characters. Specht inner products yield H5=sign-twisted 7-point permutation, H7=S^(4,2,1)+S^(4,1,1,1), H8=trivial; this does not rest solely on the Lefschetz alternating trace, which by itself cannot separate graded degrees.
